guard: remote managers renew stale executors, evict only their host-enumerated family, and reconcile frozen foreign holders only after affirmative liveness
command: pnpm --filter @cotal-ai/core build && pnpm --filter @cotal-ai/auth build && pnpm --filter @cotal-ai/manager build && pnpm smoke:manager-service-authority && COTAL_OWNER_NATIVE_ACCEPTANCE=1 pnpm probe:hosted-retirement-stock-supervise

mutations.name: remote registration drops host eviction wiring
mutations.expectRed: same remote manager instance restarts after clean expired-executor deregistration
mutations.cell: same remote manager instance restarts after clean expired-executor deregistration
mutations.afterRestore: pnpm --filter @cotal-ai/core build && pnpm --filter @cotal-ai/auth build && pnpm --filter @cotal-ai/manager build

mutations.name: clean stop reuses the stale remote executor
mutations.expectRed: stock clean stop refreshes the executor and deregisters after its retained credential expires
mutations.cell: stock clean stop refreshes the executor and deregisters after its retained credential expires

mutations.name: host eviction skips caller-family membership
mutations.find:
if (!holders.has(r.principal!))
      throw new EpEnvelopeError("permission-denied", `manager maintenance may evict only a holder enumerated in ${epcredFamilyPrefix("manager", r.targetInstanceId)}; ${r.principal} is outside that family`);
mutations.expectRed: host maintenance refuses a principal outside the caller instance family
mutations.cell: host maintenance refuses a principal outside the caller instance family
mutations.command: pnpm --filter @cotal-ai/core build && pnpm --filter @cotal-ai/auth build && pnpm smoke:manager-service-authority
mutations._note: This entry is graded by the auth smoke alone: it is a counting suite whose summary line prints whether it passes or fails, so it can carry its own completion marker. The shared command chains this smoke before the acceptance suite with `&&`, so under the shared marker a real kill here never reaches the acceptance banner and grades INCONCLUSIVE.

mutations.name: host reconciliation skips the affirmative liveness guard
mutations.replace: const liveness = { state: "gone", detail: "mutant skipped the oracle" } as HolderLiveness;
mutations.expectRed: a foreign manager gets in only after the holder is proven gone
mutations.cell: a foreign manager gets in only after the holder is proven gone
mutations.afterRestore: pnpm --filter @cotal-ai/core build && pnpm --filter @cotal-ai/auth build && pnpm --filter @cotal-ai/manager build
